scripts.title: vilanxware   UPD BEST HUB
scripts.features:
💰 Economy

Auto Collect — collects from every resource building on your plot

Auto Sell — sells your crops on a timer

Value Auto-Sell — uses the game's own auto-sell with a min-value % so only worthwhile resources are sold

⚔️ Combat

Deploy Now — sends your armies to take a chosen location type (ordered by money value); only targets bases you don't already own

Auto Events — automatically captures event bases (Riot Outpost / KOH / Toxic KOH) the moment they spawn and keeps re-taking them through the whole event for the rewards

Live Domination panel — shows the locations you currently hold (named + counts) and exactly what each location gives (money % + civilians)

📈 Upgrades

Auto Buy — tick which buildings to auto-purchase across Factory / Houses / Military / Special; buys the cheapest you can afford on a timer

Auto Research — auto-starts research and lets you prioritise a path (Military / Economy / Civilian)

AND A LOT OF NEW FEATURES
